core_obligations: Show that Omega_{O/A} is flat by observing that Omega_{P/A} is free over P for each object (proof lines 557-561).
Deduce that Li^*Omega_{O/A} = i^*Omega_{O/A} and describe it by the rule on objects (proof lines 561-563).
Apply the standard-resolution computation of the lower shriek and identify the result with the definition of the cotangent complex (proof lines 564-568).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a ring map A -> B with pi and i as fixed by the pi-equation, there is a canonical isomorphism L_{B/A} = Lpi_!(Li^*Omega_{O/A}) = Lpi_!(i^*Omega_{O/A}) = Lpi_!(Omega_{O/A} tensor O_B) in D(B) (source lines 545-555). The proof observes that for an object P -> B of the category the module of differentials Omega_{P/A} is free over P, so that Omega_{O/A} is flat; hence the derived pullback Li^*Omega_{O/A} coincides with the ordinary pullback and is described by the rule sending an object to Omega_{P/A} tensor_{P} B. The computation of the lower shriek along the standard resolution then identifies the value of that sheaf with the definition of the cotangent complex.
